name: Greater Parry Attack (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at paralyzing your opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Parry Attack, base attack bonus +6, Int 13.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Bonus when performing this combat maneuver against a foe. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by Improved Parry Attack. If you riposte, you also gain a +1 bonus to your attack roll.
